title: Bullet chart
description: Compact KPI bars (Stephen Few): each row shows a measure as a bar over qualitative ranges (shades of gray, the poorest darkest) with a marker at its target, on the row's own scale. Rows can mix units, so dashboards fit many KPIs in little space. Hover a row or use the arrow keys to read its value, target and range.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: ticks
props.description: Tick labels of the scales, when there is room (default `true`)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Horizontal rows or vertical columns (default `horizontal`)

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: barSize
props.description: Thickness of the value bar as a fraction of the ranges' thickness (default 0.4)

props.name: targetColor
props.description: Color of the target markers (default: the text color)

props.name: data
props.description: Rows (columns when vertical): name, value, target, ranges and scale

props.name: ranges
props.description: Qualitative ranges of the rows without `ranges`: upper bounds, ascending

props.name: rangeLabels
props.description: Names of the qualitative ranges, lowest first (tooltip)

props.name: rangeColors
props.description: Colors of the qualitative ranges, lowest first; shades of gray by default

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

<script setup lang="ts">
// One row per KPI: the bar is the value, the marker the target, the gray
// bands qualitative ranges (named by `range-labels` in the tooltip).
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { BulletChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: {
    kpis: ["Revenue (k€)", "Profit (%)", "Orders", "Satisfaction"],
    ranges: ["Poor", "Fair", "Good"],
  },
  zh: {
    kpis: ["营收（千欧元）", "利润率（%）", "订单数", "满意度"],
    ranges: ["差", "一般", "良好"],
  },
  ja: {
    kpis: ["売上（千ユーロ）", "利益率（%）", "注文数", "満足度"],
    ranges: ["不良", "普通", "良好"],
  },
  fr: {
    kpis: ["Chiffre d’affaires (k€)", "Marge (%)", "Commandes", "Satisfaction"],
    ranges: ["Faible", "Correct", "Bon"],
  },
};

// value, target, upper bounds of the ranges
const KPIS = [
  [270, 250, [150, 225, 300]],
  [22.5, 26, [20, 25, 30]],
  [1650, 2100, [1000, 2000, 2500]],
  [4.4, 4.5, [3.5, 4.25, 5]],
] as const;

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const data = computed(() =>
  KPIS.map(([value, target, ranges], i) => ({
    name: text.value.kpis[i],
    value,
    target,
    ranges,
  })),
);
</script>

<template>
  <BulletChart :data="data" :range-labels="text.ranges" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// `orientation="vertical"`: columns sharing the ranges of the component
// (`ranges`), the targets in the danger color.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { BulletChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const QUARTERS = {
  en: ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"],
  zh: ["第一季度", "第二季度", "第三季度", "第四季度"],
  ja: ["第 1 四半期", "第 2 四半期", "第 3 四半期", "第 4 四半期"],
  fr: ["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"],
};

const SALES = [82, 95, 71, 104];
const TARGETS = [90, 90, 100, 100];

const { language } = useI18n();
const data = computed(() =>
  (QUARTERS[language.value] ?? QUARTERS.en).map((name, i) => ({
    name,
    value: SALES[i],
    target: TARGETS[i],
  })),
);
</script>

<template>
  <BulletChart
    :data="data"
    orientation="vertical"
    :ranges="[60, 90, 120]"
    target-color="var(--danger-color, #dc2626)"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: Bullet chart
translationResources.description: Compact KPI bars (Stephen Few): each row shows a measure as a bar over qualitative ranges (shades of gray, the poorest darkest) with a marker at its target, on the row's own scale. Rows can mix units, so dashboards fit many KPIs in little space. Hover a row or use the arrow keys to read its value, target and range.

sales.title: Sales KPI dashboard
sales.description: Five KPIs with their own units and scales. ranges gives the poor / fair / good bounds of each row, target the marker, subtitle the unit; rangeLabels names the ranges in the tooltip.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: orientation="vertical" turns the rows into columns, here the story points of each team against its commitment. The ranges are shared by every column through the chart's ranges prop; barSize makes the bars thicker.

traffic-lights.title: Traffic-light ranges
traffic-lights.description: rangeColors replaces the grays with translucent red, amber and green, and targetColor colors the markers. min starts the availability scale at 99% so that the difference between 99.9% and 99.95% shows.

monthly.title: Month by month
monthly.description: Picking another month animates the bars toward the new values. With legend, clicking a KPI in the legend hides / shows its row.

long-names.title: Long names
long-names.description: The label column is measured: it grows to fit the longest name, up to 40% of the width; longer names wrap to two lines and end with an ellipsis. Hover a row (or focus it with the keyboard) to read the full name in the tooltip.

budget-tracker.title: Department budget tracker
budget-tracker.description: Each row compares the spending to date with the budget expected by now (target), and per-row ranges mark the comfortable, tight and over-plan zones. Bars turn red through color when a department spends faster than planned; onClick shows its variance under the chart.

live-sensors.title: Live server room sensors
live-sensors.description: Readings refresh every second (setInterval, cleared when the switch is off or on unmount); the target is the setpoint and the ranges the warning and critical thresholds. Each bar's color follows its status, and only the list of sensors out of range is announced.

training.title: Weekly training plan
training.description: A Select switches runners and the bars animate to their week. Every row is scaled on its own plan, so ticks={false} hides the unitless tick labels; renderTooltip formats the value and the plan with Intl.NumberFormat units (km, m, h) and the share of the plan.

hiring-plan.title: Hiring plan
hiring-plan.description: Hires per team against the yearly headcount plan, with a marker where the team should be by now. A Select sorts the rows by pace; legend with hidden and onToggle hides teams, kept by key so that they stay hidden when the order changes, and the summary totals the visible teams.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Quarter-to-date sales KPIs, each on its own scale, against poor / fair / good ranges and the target marker; press a row for its tooltip.

BulletChartProps.data: Rows (columns when vertical): name, subtitle, value, target, ranges and scale of each
BulletChartProps.ranges: Qualitative ranges of the rows without ranges: upper bounds, ascending
BulletChartProps.rangeLabels: Names of the qualitative ranges, lowest first (shown in the tooltip)
BulletChartProps.rangeColors: Colors of the qualitative ranges, lowest first; shades of gray by default
BulletChartProps.barSize: Thickness of the value bar as a fraction of the ranges' thickness
BulletChartProps.targetColor: Color of the target markers (the text color by default)
BulletChartProps.ticks: Shows the tick labels of the scales when there is room

BulletDatum.name: Name of the measure
BulletDatum.subtitle: Small text under the name (unit, period)
BulletDatum.value: Current value, drawn as the bar
BulletDatum.ranges: Upper bounds of the qualitative ranges, ascending (e.g. poor / fair / good); the chart's ranges when omitted
BulletDatum.min: Start of the scale (0, or the smallest value when negative, by default)
BulletDatum.max: End of the scale; the largest of the ranges, the value and the target when omitted
BulletDatum.color: Color of the bar; taken from the palette when omitted

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
